input.content:
# C++ Project Makefile
# Adjust PROJECT, SRC, INC, and TEST to match your layout.

CXX      := g++
CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -O2
LDFLAGS  :=

# Directories
SRC_DIR  := src
INC_DIR  := include
BUILD_DIR:= build
TEST_DIR := tests
BIN_DIR  := bin

# Discover sources and objects
SRCS     := $(wildcard $(SRC_DIR)/*.cpp)
OBJS     := $(patsubst $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,$(SRCS))
TEST_SRCS:= $(wildcard $(TEST_DIR)/*.cpp)
TEST_BINS:= $(patsubst $(TEST_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BIN_DIR)/%,$(TEST_SRCS))
PROJECT  := app

# Linter
LINTER   := clang-tidy
LINT_FLAGS := --checks='*,-llvm-header-guard,-fuchsia-*,-altera-*' -- -std=c++17 -I$(INC_DIR)

.PHONY: all build test lint clean

all: build

# ---------- build ----------
build: $(BIN_DIR)/$(PROJECT)

$(BIN_DIR)/$(PROJECT): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $^ -o $@ $(LDFLAGS)

$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -I$(INC_DIR) -c $< -o $@

$(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR):
	mkdir -p $@

# ---------- test ----------
test: $(TEST_BINS)
	@for t in $(TEST_BINS); do echo ">>> $$t"; $$t || exit 1; done

$(BIN_DIR)/%: $(TEST_DIR)/%.cpp $(filter-out $(BUILD_DIR)/main.o,$(OBJS)) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -I$(INC_DIR) $^ -o $@ $(LDFLAGS)

# ---------- lint ----------
lint:
	$(LINTER) $(SRCS) $(LINT_FLAGS)

# ---------- clean ----------
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)
